UP Special TET Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the notification for the Uttar Pradesh Special Teacher Eligibility Test (UP Special TET 2026) Primary and Junior Level. The online application process for UP Special TET Online Form 2026 will start from 05 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 04 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Special TET Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 03 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 05 September 2026
  • Last Date : 04 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 08 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 03 November 2026
  • Exam City Details : Before Exam
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : Notify Later
  • Result : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 300/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Notification
  • Download Syllabus
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UP Special TET Online Form 2026?

UP Special TET Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
